doctrine.title: Instagram Growth Operating Doctrine
doctrine.summary: 3 interview transcripts from IG growth educators. Covers algorithmic fundamentals, hook engineering, content pipeline, posting mechanics, level-based scaling, monetization funnel, and daily execution system. High-density operating knowledge with specific numbers, named frameworks, and sequenced protocols.
core_truths: 85% of success is allocated to hook engineering. The first 3 seconds decide reach. Everything else is secondary.
80% of effort goes to Reels. Carousels and statics are supporting formats, not growth engines.
95% of creators are held back by insufficient posting frequency, not poor content quality.
8% monthly follower growth is the baseline benchmark for small brands. Below that: diagnose before continuing.
Batch production (film / edit / schedule in blocks) is the standard workflow. Ad-hoc posting is a trap.
Brand is not following. Following = vanity metric. Brand = recognition, trust, and buyer behavior. Build brand first.
Trial Reels are the algorithmic test bed. Post to non-followers first, read the signal, then decide distribution.
The monetization funnel flows in one direction: Reels reach → Stories relationship → DM automation → offer conversion.

PBC_framework.name: PBC (Topic / Branding / Category)
PBC_framework.use: Every piece of content must be classifiable by Meta on all 3 axes before posting. Missing any = algorithmic ambiguity = suppressed reach.

hook_3s_rule.name: 3-Second Hook Rule
hook_3s_rule.use: First 3 seconds must stop the scroll AND signal the content category. Visual hook + verbal hook + pattern interrupt. Test variants.

winner_doubling_system.name: Analytics-Driven Scaling
winner_doubling_system.use: Find 3 posts that overperform (2x+ baseline reach or saves). Double down on the format, topic, and hook type. Never guess; read the data.

levels.0_to_1K: Prove the niche. Post daily. No monetization. Build 9-grid clarity. Establish PBC. Ignore vanity metrics.
levels.1K_to_10K: Find 3 content pillars that perform. Introduce Stories. Start DM automation. Soft CTA to lead magnet or link.
levels.10K_to_100K: Scale winners. Introduce paid boost on top organic performers ($5-30/day). Activate repost network. Funnel into offer.

script_to_posting_pipeline.name: Script-to-Post Pipeline
stages: 1. Ideation: keyword/trend audit + evergreen angle selection
2. Scripting: hook (3s) + value body (15-45s) + CTA (5s). Write to ear, not eye.
3. Filming: batch 5-10 pieces per session. Single location, multiple outfit/topic switches.
4. Editing: captions on-screen mandatory. Cut dead air. First frame must be visually loud.
5. Scheduling: post during peak window (7-9am, 12-1pm, 6-9pm local audience time). Minimum 4x/week Reels.
6. Engagement window: respond to every comment in first 60 minutes post-publish.

repost_system.name: Repost Network Architecture
repost_system.use: Build a 5-10 account cluster in the same niche. Cross-repost top performers within 48 hrs of original post. Do not repost flops. Tag origin account.

ten_minute_daily_system.name: 10-Minute Daily Execution Protocol
phases: Phase 1 (2 min): Check analytics. Flag any post hitting 2x baseline reach or saves.
Phase 2 (3 min): Respond to all comments on posts under 24 hrs old.
Phase 3 (3 min): DM 3-5 new engaged followers (not cold; story reply or comment trigger).
Phase 4 (2 min): Queue confirm. Verify next scheduled post is loaded and caption/hook is strong.

operating_rules: Never post without a hook script. Improvised openers kill reach.
One niche, one PBC category per account. Niche confusion = suppression.
Reels minimum 4x/week at growth phase. Drop below 3x = algorithmic cooldown.
Engagement window is non-negotiable: 60 minutes post-publish, reply to everything.
Stories are the relationship layer, not the discovery layer. Do not try to grow via Stories.
DM automation activates only after 1K followers. Before that, do it manually.
Trial Reels: use for every new format or topic test. Read reach-to-non-followers ratio. Above 40% = expand.
CTA appears once per Reel, at the end. Multiple CTAs = algorithmic flag.
Saves are the highest-quality engagement signal. Design content that earns saves.
Never delete a post. Deletion signals to the algorithm. Archive if needed.
Boost only organic winners. Never boost a post with below-average engagement rate.
Comment pods are banned. Fake engagement triggers suppression.
Caption is secondary to hook and visual. Write for the algorithm first (keywords), then the human.
Consistency over quality at 0-1K. Quality over consistency at 10K+.
Monthly analytics review: if growth is below 8%, audit niche / hook / posting cadence in that order.

specific_numbers.level_0_1K_strategy: daily posting, no monetization, niche proof

content_ideas: Hot take or contrarian opinion (comments magnet)
Tool or resource list (saves + DM trigger)
Case study or results reveal (trust builder)
Stitch or response to viral content in niche

monetization_funnel.step_1: Reels: reach non-followers at scale via hook-engineered content
monetization_funnel.step_2: Stories: convert new followers into warm audience via daily relationship content
monetization_funnel.step_3: DM Automation: trigger via Stories CTA (poll / question / link tap)
monetization_funnel.step_4: Offer conversion: low-ticket lead magnet or discovery call booking from DM sequence

contradictions_resolved: Quality vs. quantity: At 0-1K, quantity wins (algorithm needs signal volume). At 10K+, quality wins (audience retains based on standard).
Reels vs. carousels: Reels for discovery growth. Carousels for saves and depth with existing audience. Not interchangeable.
Engagement pods: Short-term metric bump, long-term suppression. Never use.
Posting time: Peak windows matter at small account size. At 50K+ the algorithm self-distributes regardless of post time.
Hashtags: Deprecated as primary discovery mechanism post-2023. Use 3-5 niche-relevant only. Not a growth lever.
weird_gold_insights: The algorithm classifies your account, not your posts. Consistent PBC = account-level category lock = sustained distribution.
Trial Reels that fail are not wasted: they prevent a bad post from poisoning your account's reach score.
The 60-minute engagement window works because it signals to Meta that your content generates real-time conversation (a proxy for quality).
Saves are weighted above likes and comments in the current algorithm because they signal intent to return.
Most accounts that 'plateau' are actually category-confused, not content-depleted. Audit PBC first.
DM automation converts at 3-5x the rate of link-in-bio CTAs because it meets the buyer where attention already is.
Reposting network architecture is the closest legal equivalent to paid distribution for organic creators.
The 10-minute daily system exists because inconsistent micro-engagement is more damaging than no engagement. Daily contact beats weekly sprints.
tools_referenced: Notion or spreadsheet (content calendar + batch tracking)
Trending audio tools (TrendTok, native IG audio tab)

direct_applies: PBC framework: every SNIPED Reel must be category-locked (photography / LA founder / luxury editorial). Apply before scheduling.
Hook engineering: 3-second hook is the primary edit gate for every Reel. Concept is secondary to the hook.
Trial Reels: test new composite environments or cultural doc formats via Trial before full push.
10-minute daily system: operationalize into SNIPED daily execution protocol.
Monetization funnel: Reels reach → Stories relationship → DM CTA → VIB outreach or booking link.
Level framework: SNIPED is in the 1K-10K phase. Priority: 3 content pillars, Stories activation, soft DM CTA.
Batch production: aligns with existing shoot-day + post-shoot OS. Extend into Reel batch editing sessions.
does_not_apply: Repost network: SNIPED is a brand account, not a creator cluster. Architecture is irrelevant until a fan-page strategy activates.
Comment pods: confirmed banned. Not a consideration.
Hashtag growth strategy: deprecated. Confirmed not a lever.

notes: Full doc = 3 educator interview transcripts, 12 segments. Part 1 (seg 1-10) covered algorithmic fundamentals, hook strategy, analytics scaling, and monetization funnel. Part 2 (seg 11-12) added script-to-post pipeline, level progression framework, trial Reels mechanics, repost network architecture, and 10-minute daily system. No material contradictions between parts. Consolidated without duplication. All numeric claims retained verbatim from source. SNIPED applicability section added per OS protocol.
